signal.style_summary: Casual, warm, mostly capitalized starts but never ends with periods. Half fragments, half full sentences. Frequent exclamation marks for enthusiasm. Rare emoji. Uses 'haha'/'hehe' for laughter, not 'lol'. Hedges with 'I think' and 'I mean'. Greets with 'Hey' or 'Hi'. Stream-of-consciousness in longer messages with comma splices.

imessage.style_summary: Nearly always capitalizes first word. Zero periods at end of messages. Mix of fragments and full thoughts. 'Hey' is dominant greeting (often 'Hey!' or 'Hey dude!'). Warm and enthusiastic. Uses 'whatcha' and 'gonna' casually. Longer messages become stream-of-consciousness connected with 'and' and 'but'. Occasional lowercase 'i' in rapid texting but mostly uppercase.

slack.style_summary: Always capitalizes. 'Hey hey' is signature Slack greeting. More exclamation marks than any other platform (36%). Zero periods. Longer messages, fewer fragments. Uses em dashes. Professional but warm and enthusiastic. 'Awesome!' and 'Sounds good' are common affirmations. Frequent scheduling language ('push', 'jump on', 'dive in'). Uses Slack emoji notation rather than Unicode.

gmail.style_summary: Most formal register but still conversational. Always 'Hi [Name]' greeting. Full sentences, longer messages. Heavy contraction usage even in professional context (66%). Uses comma splices to connect thoughts. Warm and personable even in business emails. Uses 'I think' as primary hedge. Rare exclamation marks. Almost never ends with a period either.
